mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where CPI YoY growth exceeds 2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased production costs, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 4%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals increased demand for housing and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines by more than 2% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) coupled with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals robust consumer demand and a healthy labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: healthy labor market with strong demand
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances following a decrease in FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 declines by more than 1% QoQ, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
